title: Expanse
summary: EXPANSE, noun expans'. [Latin expansum.] A spreading; extend; a wide extent of space or body; as the expanse of heave. The smooth expanse of crystal lakes.

inlines.v: EXPANSE, noun expans'. [Latin expansum.] A spreading; extend; a wide extent of space or body; as the expanse of heave. The smooth expanse of crystal lakes.
